abilities.name: Bind
abilities.grants: Focus/healing by consuming a full Silk spool
abilities.note: A form of Focus; consumes a full Silk spool to regain health (Masks)

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.grants: Access to spirit boss fights and collection of Essence
abilities.note: Required to fight Elder Hu's spirit; collects 100 Essence upon his defeat

abilities.name: Needle
abilities.grants: Main weapon: slash, block, dash-stab, bounce, grappling hook, fills Silk spool by two laces per hit
abilities.note: Hornet's primary weapon; versatile offensive and traversal tool

abilities.name: Tools
abilities.grants: Throwing weapons or defensive aids without costing Silk
abilities.note: Equipped on a Crest with limited slots; changed at a Bench similar to Charms

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Spirit fought at his memorial above the City of Tears gates after acquiring the Dream Nail. Attacks: Ring Slam (row of rings slammed to the ground) and teleport. Drops 100 Essence on defeat.

objectives.name: Acquire the Dream Nail
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain the Dream Nail key item to unlock access to spirit boss fights

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu's spirit at his memorial
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the memorial above the City of Tears gates and use the Dream Nail to engage Elder Hu's spirit

objectives.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat Elder Hu's spirit; use the Dream Nail to absorb the 100 Essence he shatters into

objectives.name: Encounter Garmond and Zaza
